sources: sec edgar submissions api, 8-K item 2.02 acceptance times

history.basis: all 66 prior print(s) on this CIK were filed under a former name before 2026-07-17, so they belong to a predecessor entity and are not this company's reaction history

event_plausibility.reason: UPGRADE off 'unknown'. Zumiez is a long-listed domestic retailer and the 'unknown' rests on history.n=0, which is a COLLECTION FAILURE and not a cadence problem -- the same records artefact as PANW, CXM and MEI on earlier runs. The event itself is confirmed by the company's own GlobeNewswire release of 2026-08-27: fiscal 2026 Q2 results 'following the closing of regular stock market trading hours' on 2026-09-10, call 5:00 p.m. ET. The thin history is NOT forgiven by this: hist_n stays 0 and the name still pays for it in baseline_quality, and its hunter is told explicitly that the baseline carries NO earnings base rate and that the absence is an artefact, so it must not read the silence as a quiet history.

amended_from.reason: fewer than 3 prior prints to infer a cadence from

event_plausibility.amended_by: edge sweep, company-sourced; before any hunter launched

options.event_implied_move_basis: straddle taken as-is (no vol anchor to net off)
options.skew_note: IV(25d put) - IV(25d call). Positive = the market is paying more for downside protection than for upside.
warnings: ATM bid-ask spread 100% of mid; too wide to mean anything

deadband_basis: one day at 20d realised vol (no earnings history on EDGAR)
deadband_note: A realised move inside this band is scored as no-direction rather than as a miss.
expected_move_basis: median historical reaction (no usable option chain)

baseline_quality.note: thin means there is no reliable statement of what the market priced, so a confident call on this name cannot be justified by the baseline.
